goal: Prove offline D-0019 -> D-0018 -> D-0017 composition with fail-closed tamper coverage.
preflight: Confirm the repository is mrhz1973/control-plane and the intended target branch is main.
Read the checkpoint contract and final report contract before editing.
Inspect the current implementations and tests only within the allowed paths.
Record the initial worktree state; preserve unrelated existing changes and stop if unexpected changes appear during execution.
Confirm the validation can run offline without provider or n8n access.
steps: Create the required execution checkpoint before implementation, using the checkpoint contract and limiting the read/edit scope to the declared paths.
Inspect D-0019 request construction, D-0018 planner-response gate validation, and D-0017 execution-packet validation interfaces represented by the allowed tool files.
Implement or refine the offline round-trip fixture and runner under tests/openclaw-consumer-roundtrip/ so canonical data composes through D-0019 -> D-0018 -> D-0017 without network or provider calls.
Add bounded tamper cases under tests/openclaw-consumer-roundtrip/ that alter relevant boundary data and assert fail-closed rejection with explicit expected classifications.
Make only the minimum compatibility fixes needed in the three allowed tool files if the offline composition test exposes an interface defect; do not modify runtime, deployment, or n8n surfaces.
Run the seeded offline validation, resolve failures only within allowed paths, and capture command results for the final report.
Perform the required BugBot review, address in-scope findings within the review-round limit, rerun validation after any fix, and produce the final report using the required contract.
validation: Verify the canonical fixture reports PASS for the complete D-0019 -> D-0018 -> D-0017 offline path.
Verify every tamper fixture exits or reports failure and matches its declared classification.
Verify changed files are confined to allowed_paths and no forbidden path was accessed or mutated.
Verify the test and implementation make no provider, n8n, VPS, or OpenClaw runtime calls.
acceptance: Tamper cases fail-closed with expected classifications

stop_when: The canonical offline round trip passes.
All declared tamper cases fail closed with their expected classifications.
The seeded validation command exits successfully.
No changes exist outside allowed paths.

reasons: The requested work is bounded to offline tooling and test paths.
The supplied validation is a local Node.js command.
Runtime, VPS, n8n, and provider interactions are excluded.
